title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.30949v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities. translated_title: IQuest-Q1：推进智能体CLI系统的基础能力
translated_abstract: 我们提出了IQuest-Q1，一个总参数量为320B（激活参数15B）的稀疏混合专家（MoE）智能体基础模型。IQuest-Q1通过三阶段流程开发：（1）稳定高效的预训练，结合Stable SplitNorm、Muon和muP，并采用两阶段课程学习，其第二阶段提高了代码数据的配比，在安全学习率与最优学习率之间保持了较宽的稳定性余量；（2）细粒度的中期训练，扩展跨领域、跨格式的数据配比，并逐步延长上下文长度；（3）多脚手架多版本后训练，在多种脚手架下结合SFT、领域专用强化学习和MOPD，以整合互补的训练信号并强化智能体编码能力。此外，模型合并将来自不同阶段的多个专家和检查点结合起来，同时缓解其参数更新之间的冲突。由此得到的IQuest-Q1展现出……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: IQuest-Q1是一个总参数320B（激活15B）的稀疏MoE智能体基础模型，通过稳定预训练、细粒度中期训练和多脚手架多版本后训练的三阶段流程，显著提升了智能体CLI系统的基础与编码能力。
en_tdlr: IQuest-Q1 is a sparse MoE agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated), built through a three-stage pipeline of stable pre-training, fine-grained mid-training, and multi-scaffold multi-version post-training to advance foundation capabilities for agentic CLI systems.
